topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: I came home from the store, bags in hand, expecting a routine trip inside. The driveway was empty, too empty—it hit me, the car was gone. I checked the street, hoping it was just parked elsewhere, but no luck. Then I saw the note, a stark piece of paper, coldly explaining the car had been towed, without a hint of apology. I don’t understand how this could happen on my own property. The weight of it all, the inconvenience, the costs, it just feels overwhelming. I stood there, the grocery bags getting heavier, the quiet of the neighborhood mocking the chaos of this moment.
